notes.title: Supported on Steam Deck!
notes.notes:
Hello there,

The release of our newest game "Only an Alien Going Up!" is close and we would like to share that the game has been tested and can be played on the Steam Deck without any extra setup steps.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44699552/0704ee015519e2fa65772aa12a763efabdd4dc5a.png[/img]

We hope this is a pleasant addition for owners of the portable, as we are working to have all of our games supported and officially verified by Valve in the future.

Enjoy,

Vutune Team
